name: Pastor James Ssemwanga
bio: Pastor James founded Amazing Media Uganda with a passion to use modern technology to spread the Gospel. He brings over 15 years of pastoral ministry experience.

name: Sarah Nakato
bio: Sarah leads all broadcasting, livestreaming, and digital production operations. She is passionate about connecting technology and worship.

name: David Mutebi
bio: David leads our praise ministries and oversees all gospel music production, ensuring every note glorifies Christ.

name: Dr. Ruth Namukasa
bio: Dr. Ruth leads our health education and community outreach initiatives, promoting holistic wellness rooted in Biblical principles.
